{"metadata":{"description":"Configure proxy for deepseek harness","id":"gh:1388885608","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-proxy","slug":"copylee711/dsh-proxy","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","proxy"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Configure proxy for deepseek harness"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# @copylee/dsh-proxy"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A network proxy plugin for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`):"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- **Global proxy**: enter `http://127.0.0.1:7890` under **Settings → Network proxy**, and model requ"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ests, web search, web fetch, HTTP MCP, and commands the agent runs all go through it.
- **Per-provid"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"er proxy**: give one model provider its own proxy or force it direct. For example, Anthropic through"},{"id":"p5s4","text":" `http://127.0.0.1:7890` and DeepSeek direct.
- **Applies on save**: no dsh restart needed."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Precedence: provider setting > global proxy > `HTTP(S)_PROXY` from launch."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Restart `dsh web`, and a **Network proxy** page appears in Settings."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"> Keep the `@copylee/` scope. The unscoped `dsh-proxy` and `dsh-network-proxy` packages on npm belon"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"g to other people and are unrelated."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"You can also install straight from GitHub. Built output is committed, so no build script or `allowBu"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ilds` entry is needed:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Use"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Open **Settings → Network proxy**:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Area | What it does |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Global proxy | Tick **Enabled** and enter the proxy URL. **Hosts that bypass the proxy** takes one"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" host per line and matches subdomains too. `localhost` / `127.0.0.1` are always direct. |
| Per-prov"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ider proxy | Lists configured model providers. Each can be **Follow global**, **Use proxy**, or **Di"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"rect**. Add a provider not in the list by typing its id below it (e.g. `deepseek-official`, `anthrop"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"ic`, `openai`, or a custom Provider ID from the Models page). |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"**Save** applies to the next request, including **Fetch available models** on the Models page."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### System proxy"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The global selector offers Off (use launch settings), System proxy (auto-detect), and Manual proxy. "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"Each provider can also select its own system proxy, overriding the global route. Menus follow dsh-fr"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"ee-search's floating cards, hover highlights, and selection checkmarks, with Arrow, Home/End, Enter,"},{"id":"p19s4","text":" Esc, and Tab keyboard support."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Detection tries valid HTTP(S) values from HTTPS_PROXY / https_proxy, HTTP_PROXY / http_proxy, and AL"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"L_PROXY / all_proxy in that order, then Windows current-user Internet Settings or macOS scutil. Linu"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"x uses environment variables. A launch environment snapshot prevents the plugin's own installed prox"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"y from feeding back into detection. OS settings are checked every 30 seconds; the settings page also"},{"id":"p20s5","text":" offers Detect again. SOCKS, PAC, and WPAD are not supported. When detection finds no usable proxy, "},{"id":"p20s6","text":"the global layer restores launch settings and provider overrides fall back to the global route with "},{"id":"p20s7","text":"a warning. Status and logs mask proxy credentials."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Existing configurations without mode continue using their manual proxy. The global proxy remains dis"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ations without mode continue using their manual proxy. The global proxy remains disabled by default."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Accent colour"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The bottom of the page offers an accent colour (terracotta, blue or black) for the primary button an"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"d focus rings. The choice is shared with the other copylee plugins: changing it in any one of them r"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ecolours all of them."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### Configuration file"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The same settings live in `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` (the Web UI profile is `we"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"same settings live in `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` (the Web UI profile is `web`):"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| Field | Meaning |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| `global.enabled` | Turn the global proxy on. Default `false`, which keeps the launch environment's"},{"id":"p29s2","text":" proxy. |
| `global.url` | Global proxy URL. |
| `global.noProxy` | Hosts reached directly while the"},{"id":"p29s3","text":" global proxy is on. |
| `providers.<id>.enabled` | Use this provider's own setting. Default `true`;"},{"id":"p29s4","text":" `false` follows the global route. |
| `providers.<id>.mode` | `proxy` (use `url`) or `direct` (bypa"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"ss every proxy, the global one included). |
| `providers.<id>.url` | This provider's proxy URL. |"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Proxy URLs may be `http://` or `https://`. A bare `127.0.0.1:7890` becomes `http://127.0.0.1:7890`. "},{"id":"p30s2","text":"Credentials go in the URL: `http://user:password@host:port`."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- **Global proxy** installs through dsh's own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-http-proxy`, the package the launche"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"r uses for `HTTP(S)_PROXY`. Loopback bypass, `NO_PROXY` matching, `web_fetch` routing, and the proxy"},{"id":"p32s3","text":" environment of spawned tools therefore behave exactly as upstream. Turning it off restores the laun"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"ch policy.
- **Per-provider proxy** hooks the `llm/stream` middleware. A provider's model call runs "},{"id":"p32s5","text":"in one async context. The plugin puts that provider's undici `ProxyAgent` (or a direct `Agent`) in a"},{"id":"p32s6","text":"n AsyncLocalStorage, and `fetch` uses it inside that context. Other requests are untouched, and conc"},{"id":"p32s7","text":"urrent calls to different providers don't interfere.
- Both sections are Cordis volatile fields. Sav"},{"id":"p32s8","text":"ing in Settings fires `loader/volatile-update`, and the plugin switches routes in place without relo"},{"id":"p32s9","text":" Settings fires `loader/volatile-update`, and the plugin switches routes in place without reloading."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Limits"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"- **HTTP(S) proxies only; SOCKS5 is not supported.** The "mixed port" of Clash, v2rayN, and similar "},{"id":"p34s2","text":"apps (e.g. 7890) also speaks HTTP, so use that port.
- **Per-provider routes cover that provider's m"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"odel requests only** (including model discovery). Web search, web fetch, and other traffic use the g"},{"id":"p34s4","text":"lobal route.
- **Credentials are stored in plain text.** A username and password in the URL are save"},{"id":"p34s5","text":"d in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. The global proxy URL also reaches commands the agent runs thr"},{"id":"p34s6","text":"ough their environment.
- **Telemetry stays direct.** It uses Node's `http` module, as it does in up"},{"id":"p34s7","text":"environment.
- **Telemetry stays direct.** It uses Node's `http` module, as it does in upstream dsh."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## Develop"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"Try it in a local dsh: `dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-proxy`."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
